name: DINKFLIX Web
overview: A premium, lightweight desktop redesign for Jellyfin Web.
description: A desktop-first DINKFLIX web experience with a full-width hero, cleaner navigation, richer cards, per-user My List, library browsing, search and custom title pages.

versions.changelog: DINKFLIX Web 6.0.0.0: premium desktop navigation, full-width hero, wider discovery cards, My List, search, richer title pages and native Jellyfin fallbacks.
